description: FIND-013 suggested that calculateCancelAcceptanceStart should use property-based testing (fast-check) in addition to the case table, since date arithmetic with month-end rollup is complex. The verification architecture (line 76) still lists 'Vitest unit tests (boundary cases: 3/31->2/28, 5/31->4/30, leap year)' without adding a property-based test. This was a LOW finding in iteration-1 and was not listed in the fixesSummary. The case table approach remains adequate for a spec review, but the recommendation stands for implementation phase.
